name: adc_regularconversion_interrupt
description: ADC_RegularConversion_Interrupt: ADC1 converts channel 10 (PC0, Arduino A1 on CN9 pin 3) continuously at 22.5 MHz with 3-cycle sampling, the reference VDDA at 3.3 V; 1.0 V from a source on A1 reads as floor(1.0 x 4096 / 3.3) = 1241 in uhADCxConvertedValue; the end-of-conversion callback reads it; LD2 (an error) stays dark.
